correctness.rationale: The exact discounted Dirichlet equations reduce to a positive-denominator multipartite profile identity, whose validity follows from the unique equilibrium. The three exhaustive source profiles have exact rational worst supports eta111, eta210, eta300. Both differences are explicitly positive for integer m>=4, 0<lambda<1. Inclusion monotonicity excludes fewer than three sources and counts exactly m^3 minima. Proof includes m=3 counter-boundary. The standalone verifier independently compares 27 full polynomials and 162 exact vertex-level systems; finite tests do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: An emerging random-walk domination invariant exhibits a nonempty parameter interval for every m>=4 and every homogeneous discount, in which all and only optimal 3-source configurations have full three-part coverage; the m^3 census and sharp m=3 obstruction resolve a natural structural threshold question beyond the scalar invariant. A general exact multipartite profile enumerator also follows as a reproducible tool.
